# StatusDot

A compact semantic status mark with an optional pulse.

## Props

| Prop | Requirement | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | Optional | `neutral`, `accent`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` | Argo semantic tone. |
| `pulse` | Optional | boolean | Whether to animate the status pulse. |
| `accessibilityLabel` | Optional | string | The visible and accessible label. |

## Slots

This part has no named Slots.

Does not accept child nodes on the wire.

## Accessibility

- **Accessible name:** `accessibilityLabel` when supplied.
- **Keyboard:** StatusDot adds no keyboard focus stop; informative status is announced in reading order.
- **VoiceOver:** VoiceOver skips a decorative StatusDot and announces accessibilityLabel when the mark conveys status.
- **TalkBack:** TalkBack skips a decorative StatusDot and announces accessibilityLabel when the mark conveys status.
